title: Generated package artifacts under src are unignored and uncleaned
description: Evidence: .gitignore ignores dist and tsbuildinfo but not packages/*/src generated .js/.d.ts maps; package clean removes dist and tsbuildinfo only; current git status shows 72 untracked generated files under packages/*/src even though package exports point at dist. Impact: stale generated artifacts can be accidentally committed under source.
acceptanceCriteria: Repo clean/ignore policy prevents generated src-side JS/d.ts/map artifacts from lingering or being committed, and package exports remain dist-based.
